title: Multilingual Artificial Datasets for AI-Driven Cardiology: the CliTe and ParaCliTe corpora
abstract: arXiv:2611.09296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background and Aims. Comparable, multilingual, validated cardiology corpora are critical to advance trustworthy natural language processing (NLP) models for cardiology but such resources are scarce due to privacy concerns. This study aimed to cover this gap by presenting suitable artificial corpus creation guidelines and by releasing 3 multilanguage corpora. Methods. Following purpose-specific publicly-available corpus construction guidelines, cardiologists from 7 European hospitals generated artificial clinical records in Czech, Dutch, English, Italian, Romanian, Spanish and Swedish, ensuring clinical diversity and sex balance, resulting in the CliTe corpus. A CliTe subset underwent a multi-stage manual translation into the other 6 languages, resulting in the parallel ParaCliTe corpus, while the remaining reports were automatically translated, constituting ParaCliTe Silver. translated_title: 面向人工智能驱动心脏病学的多语言人工数据集：CliTe 与 ParaCliTe 语料库
translated_abstract: 背景与目的。可比对的、多语言的、经验证的心脏病学语料库对于推进可信赖的心脏病学自然语言处理（NLP）模型至关重要，但由于隐私问题，此类资源十分稀缺。本研究旨在通过提出合适的人工语料库构建指南并发布3个多语言语料库来填补这一空白。方法。遵循特定用途的公开语料库构建指南，来自7家欧洲医院的心脏病医生生成了捷克语、荷兰语、英语、意大利语、罗马尼亚语、西班牙语和瑞典语的人工临床记录，确保了临床多样性和性别平衡，由此形成了 CliTe 语料库。CliTe 的一个子集经过多阶段人工翻译成其他6种语言，形成了平行语料库 ParaCliTe，其余报告则通过机器翻译构成了 ParaCliTe Silver。结果。CliTe 是包含699份人工心脏病学报告的集合。
tldr: 该研究提出人工临床语料库构建指南，并发布了由7家欧洲医院心脏病医生撰写的涵盖7种语言的人工心脏病学语料库 CliTe 及其平行翻译语料库 ParaCliTe，在规避隐私问题的同时为多语言心脏病学 NLP 模型的可信发展提供了稀缺的高质量数据资源。
